en.title: The Ultramarine Labyrinth and the Golden Testament
en.premise: Having restored her honor and deepened her bond with Crown Prince Julian, Eleanor now faces a new trial. A single "testament" and "secret map" left behind by her late father draw her toward an even deeper taboo lurking at the empire's core. Amidst the high-stakes social warfare of a lavish masquerade ball and the mystery of a labyrinth lost to the shadows of history, love and conspiracy intersect as the fateful second act begins.

zh.title: 绀青迷宫与黄金遗言
zh.premise: 恢复了名誉、并与皇太子朱利安加深了羁绊的埃莉诺。然而，已故父亲留下一封“遗言”与“秘密地图”，将她引向潜藏于帝国根源的更深禁忌。金碧辉煌的舞会社交战，以及消失在历史阴暗中的迷宫之谜。爱与阴谋交织，命运的第二幕正式拉开序幕。
